channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: A German politician with a MAGA touch lifts his nationalist party to victory
item.dc:creator: Maegan Vazquez, Mary Ilyushina
item.description: Ulrich Siegmund and his Alternative for Germany party sent tremors through establishment political circles in Berlin, Brussels and other capitals across Europe.

item.title: They formed to fight Haiti’s gangs. Now they’re an obstacle to peace.
item.dc:creator: Widlore Mérancourt
item.description: As a U.S.-backed, U.N.-authorized force attempts to restore security, “self-defense brigades” pose a unique challenge.

item.title: Nationalist AfD wins key regional election in Germany but falls short of majority
item.dc:creator: Mary Ilyushina, Maegan Vazquez
item.description: Alternative for Germany, labeled “extremist” by German authorities, polled first in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt but still might not control the government.

item.title: In Kyiv, U.S. envoys say push is on for trilateral talks to end Russia’s war
item.dc:creator: Serhii Korolchuk, Aoife Walsh, Anastacia Galouchka
item.description: Sunday’s visit by Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner marks the first by President Donald Trump’s emissaries to the Ukrainian capital.

item.title: U.S. energy secretary says Iran nuclear deal ‘may not’ happen anytime soon
item.dc:creator: Violet Jira, Aoife Walsh, Mohamad El Chamaa
item.description: Military action is still needed to deal with the threat from Tehran, Chris Wright said on ABC’s “This Week.”

item.title: Deadly Iran wedding strike likely due to U.S. bomb missing a nearby target
item.dc:creator: Alex Horton, Joyce Lee
item.description: Six bombs dropped by Navy jets targeted a communications complex in the coastal town of Kuhestak. One missed.

item.title: In rare flurry of trips, Xi pitches China as stable alternative to U.S. under Trump
item.dc:creator: Joshua Yang
item.description: Ahead of a state dinner with President Donald Trump, China’s Xi Jinping is courting global influence.

item.title: U.S. military says it hit 3 Iranian tankers after Navy ships targeted
item.dc:creator: Mohamad El Chamaa, Sammy Westfall
item.description: U.S. Central Command said it struck an Iranian oil tanker off the coast of Kharg Island, as well as off Jask and the Gulf of Oman.

item.title: U.S. envoys meet Putin in Moscow, pressing Russia-Ukraine peace talks
item.dc:creator: Mary Ilyushina, Victoria Craw, Natalia Abbakumova
item.description: The visit by Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner was aimed at reviving negotiations that have been in a deep freeze for nearly eight months.

item.title: After nine months at sea, a muted stay in Thailand for crew of USS Abraham Lincoln
item.dc:creator: Andrew Nachemson
item.description: The aircraft carrier’s record-long Iran war deployment, which some of the crew described as a grueling odyssey, is winding down at last.

item.title: The U.N. backed a map that shows Africa true to size. The U.S. was sole objector.
item.dc:creator: Victoria Craw
item.description: The U.S. was the only country to vote against the U.N. resolution, which encourages the use of an “Equal Earth” map. The U.S. described it as a “radical ideological project.”
